resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association's Denning point lies south-west of its own San Augustine point, while TSHA places the community of Denning in the northwest of the county. The story reports both and does not treat the lookout as being at the community.

notes_for_editor: Low confidence. Sources are the association listing (coordinates and Tower Gone), the TSHA entry for the Denning community, and a Texas Escapes background article. No source ties this lookout to the community or gives its build date, agency, design or staffing. A Shelby County Today column by Neal Murphy (https://scttx.com/articles/fire-towers-neal-murphy) describes a Forest Service tower just west of San Augustine, off Highway 21 on CR 280, which it says was torn down. The column does not mention Denning. It is not used here, and it may describe the San Augustine listing rather than this one. A Texas Escapes page on Denning describes the old community buildings and does not mention a lookout. A human should check whether the listed coordinates are at the community or elsewhere before publishing.
